text: 【美国8月CPI前瞻：能源涨价扰动通胀 美联储加息预期面临关键检验】北京时间9月11日20时30分，美国将公布8月消费者价格指数（CPI）。在油价上涨、生产端价格压力持续的背景下，这份美联储9月议息会议前的关键通胀报告，将为利率决策提供重要依据，并牵动全球股债汇市场走势。
text_en: [US August CPI Preview: Energy price increases disrupt inflation, Fed rate expectations face key test] At 20:30 Beijing time on September 11, the US will release the August Consumer Price Index (CPI). Against the backdrop of rising oil prices and persistent producer-side price pressure, this key inflation report before the Fed's September policy meeting will provide an important basis for interest rate decisions and affect global stock, bond, and currency market trends.
